DIAGNOSTICS (hypotheses to test, not verdicts)
  ⚠ HIGH  context_bloat  ·  8/8 runs (100%)  ·  coordinator 8, synthesizer 8
      Observed:   synthesizer's largest prompt was 9,088 tokens, 57.9× the 157 tokens traceable to its
                  recorded inputs (1 such call(s), 8,931 untraced tokens in total).
      Hypothesis: synthesizer may be receiving more context than its task needs, or reading inputs that
                  were not recorded.
      Test:       Re-run with synthesizer's prompt limited to its recorded inputs and compare success
                  and cost.
  ⚠ HIGH  under_specialization  ·  8/8 runs (100%)  ·  researcher_a 8, researcher_c 8
      Observed:   researcher_a and researcher_c share the role 'research'; 100% of their distinct tool
                  calls overlap (Jaccard, 2 shared) and 1 of their artifacts match each other (68%
                  similar).
      Hypothesis: The two research agents may not have distinct responsibilities, which is consistent
                  with overlapping scopes in their instructions.
      Test:       Re-run with disjoint scopes for researcher_a and researcher_c (or with one of them
                  removed) and compare success and cost.
  ⚠ MED   coordinator_bottleneck  ·  8/8 runs (100%)  ·  coordinator 8
      Observed:   coordinator took part in 100% of 9 messages, with 5 peers; 40% of the messages it sent
                  passed on other agents' artifacts; its own calls are 29% of the critical path (11.6s
                  of 40.0s).
      Hypothesis: Routing work through coordinator may be lengthening the run and concentrating failure
                  risk in one agent.
      Test:       Re-run with direct hand-offs between coordinator's peers (bypassing coordinator for
                  relays) and compare wall clock, success and cost.
  ⚠ MED   dead_agent  ·  8/8 runs (100%)  ·  researcher_c 8
      Observed:   researcher_c used 3% of the run's tokens; none of its 1 artifact(s) or 1 message(s)
                  was observed in use by another agent (provenance coverage 100%).
      Hypothesis: researcher_c's work may not be reaching the result; removing it is consistent with the
                  record, but only an ablation can show its effect on success.
      Test:       Re-run without researcher_c and compare success and cost.
  ⚠ MED   redundant_delegation  ·  8/8 runs (100%)  ·  coordinator 8, researcher_a 8, researcher_c 8
      Observed:   coordinator delegated to researcher_a and researcher_c, who then made 2 identical tool
                  call(s) (web_search); the most similar pair of their assignments was 100% similar.
      Hypothesis: The delegation may be giving researcher_a and researcher_c overlapping scopes, so the
                  same lookups are repeated.
      Test:       Re-run with disjoint scopes for researcher_a and researcher_c (or with one of them
                  removed) and compare success and cost.
